Required behavior: Read AI_IMPORT_DESTINATIONS as candidate seed data. DISCOVERY_BACKLOG is excluded from guest recommendations. No historical property or archetype sheet is included.
A candidate_status of CANDIDATE_ONLY is not approval for guest display. Verify the destination claim against its source, then match the actual guest intake and live inventory.

Every source claim is pending explicit review. Destination_source_url may be a broad tourism page or property context. If it does not support the exact claim and place, fetch a destination-specific source or withhold that claim. Never turn source_scope into a fact.

Use up to two guest-selected desired feelings as primary signals; match concrete interests, setting, pace and travel party. Themes are editorial hypotheses and can blend. No promise of an emotional result, diagnosis, or required spa/spiritual program.
Filter must-avoid and accessibility requirements before ranking. Unknown high-impact suitability is not a pass. Use prefer-avoid as a penalty or explain the tradeoff.
Only claim live hotel availability and price with exact check-in/out, party ages, rooms, currency and booker eligibility. Flexible month is inspiration only.

USD per room per night slider. For the full required room configuration compare mandatory payable amount divided by nights to slider maximum; preserve original currency and conversion provenance. Blank verified_nightly_usd means UNKNOWN, never zero.
Fetch current products and extra_charges. Label search/availability prices estimated. Confirm final amount using orders/preview before booking; rerun on handoff. API results can change.

Google place ID and status establish an identifiable business; opening hours may cover only a short future window and do not prove ticket or activity availability. Confirm time-sensitive activities with the operator.
Use actual travel origin, mode, dates and transfer legs; a gateway hint or straight-line distance is insufficient.

Return 2–3 diverse options when available. Tie each reason to guest words and a specific checked feature. Show a material tradeoff, unresolved facts and quote timestamp/estimated status. Let guest refine the fit.
Say which constraint prevents a grounded match and ask which one may flex. Do not relax budget or must-avoid silently.
Use current official destination/entry guidance and individual travel details. Neither Maps nor a tourism listing verifies entry, accessibility, or safety.
Record evidence URL or API ID, timestamp, dates and outcome. On API failure mark UNVERIFIED. Do not send private emotional free text to travel APIs or logs.

Catalog data snapshot: 2026-09-24. 72 editorial candidate records; 928 geographic backlog records. No hotel IDs, prices, rates, availability, tickets or final itineraries have been verified in this file.
